markscheme.html:
a

The collisions are elastic ✓ The time for a collision is much shorter than the time between collisions ✓ The intermolecular forces are only present during collisions ✓

b

The momentum of a molecule changes when it collides with a container wall ✓ From  and Newton’s third law, this leads to a force exerted on the wall by the molecule ✓ The average force exerted by all the molecules on a unit area of the wall is equivalent to pressure ✓

c

 ✓ 100 «kPa» ✓

question.html:
a State two assumptions of the kinetic model of an ideal gas that refer to intermolecular collisions. [2]

b Discuss how the motion of the molecules of a gas gives rise to pressure in the gas. [3]

c The average speed of the molecules of a gas is 500 m s−1. The density of the gas is 1.2 kg m−3. Calculate, in kPa, the pressure of the gas. [2]
